name: Ore no Hitomi de Maruhadaka! Fukachi na Mirai to Misukasu Vision
original_name: 俺の瞳で丸裸！不可知な未来と視透かす運命
source:
"Oh, my. It's been a long time since we have a guest."

"For now, this is how it's gonna be. 
Anything you like over there, just one, you can take it with you."

In the suburbs, deep in the forest, lies the "Witch's House." When they were young, a group of six childhood friends successfully visited the place. Each of them were given and took home, magical items. However―― Only one boy was different.

"I don't want anything. Instead, I want to learn magic, let me be your apprentice――!"

Some time has passed since then. The protagonist Kuze Shinra, is now spending his days as a servant of the "Witch of the Forest." Even though he is supposed to be her apprentice​, he is not taught magic at all, but is forced to do household chores every day instead.

The only thing that he has learned is the "Magic of Clairvoyance," which he only uses to see the girls around him, their naked bodies! Day after day, he uses the magic on his childhood friends. Day by day, on his growing healthy body, his nose widens.

In such a life that he leads, suddenly, a change occurs.

"I come from Toulouse, France, my name is Lucie Stella Ecarlate. 
My mission―― exterminating the witches."

From that moment, his daily life starts to change drastically. Childhood friends+1, the witches extermination, his true power, and numerous limits. But above all else―― This sudden changes in his surroundings eventually develop into romance and [i]ecchi[/i] with the girls around him!

In such a life that he leads, suddenly, a change occurs.

Following the protagonist who is a witch's servant, a magical slapstick romantic comedy begins――!

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
“哎哟，好久没来客人了。”

“现在，情况就是这样。
那里有你喜欢的任何东西，就一件，你可以带走。”

在郊区的森林深处，坐落着“魔女之家”。小时候，六位儿时好友成功地参观了这个地方。他们每个人都得到并带回家了魔法物品。然而——只有一个少年不同。

“我什么都不要，只是想学魔法，拜你为徒吧——！”

从那时起已经过去了一段时间。主人公久世新罗，现在作为“森林的魔女”的仆人度过了自己的日子。尽管他应该是她的学徒​，但他根本没有学习魔法，而是被迫每天做家务。

他唯一学会的就是“千里眼魔法”，他只能用它来看到周围的女孩子，她们赤裸的身体！日复一日，他对儿时的朋友们使用魔法。日复一日，在他日益健康的身体上，他的鼻子变宽了。

在他过的这样的生活中，突然发生了变化。

“我来自法国图卢兹，我的名字是露西·斯特拉·埃卡拉特。
我的任务——消灭魔女。”

从那一刻起，他的日常生活开始发生巨大的变化。青梅竹马+1，消灭魔女，他真正的力量，还有无数的限制。但最重要的是——周围环境的突然变化最终发展成与周围女孩的浪漫和[i]ecchi[/i]！

在他过的这样的生活中，突然发生了变化。

以魔女的仆人为主角，一场神奇的闹剧浪漫喜剧开始了——！

[翻译编辑自[url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/#story]官网[/url]]
